outcome: T1 relaxation times of neonatal brain regions (cerebral cortex, subcortical gray and white matter, centrum semiovale, posterior limb of internal capsule, globus pallidus, thalamus, occipital lobes) measured by SyMRI

T2 relaxation times of neonatal brain regions (cerebral cortex, subcortical gray and white matter, centrum semiovale, posterior limb of internal capsule, globus pallidus, thalamus, occipital lobes) measured by SyMRI
cohort: Seventy preterm and full-term infants, aged 34-42 weeks gestational age at examination, were prospectively included in the study.
finding: A significant linear and negative correlation was found between T1 and T2 relaxation times and gestational age in the neonate cerebral cortex and subcortical gray and white matter regions.
